To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a simple and cost-effective method of generating a flat, multi-wavelength optical combs with 0.5THz of bandwidth using two cascaded electro-optic modulators is presented.

the use of two concatenated low voltage electro-optic modulators is a simple, cost-effective, and efficient technique to generate an optical comb with 11 channels, a line spacing of 42.6GHz, a total bandwidth of over 500 GHz and a flatness below -2dB.
a multi-wavelength optical source can be generated using two concatenated electro-optic modulators driven with a low drive voltage of 3.6 V(pi) per modulator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of multi-wavelength comb sources with low drive voltage amplitude modulators for use in optical communications.
the design and development of novel optical sources for high-speed optical communications.
the design and implementation of a simple and cost-effective optical comb generator using two cascaded modulators, which can be used as a multi-wavelength source in optical communications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented technique provides an efficient and cost-effective way to obtain flat and stable multi-wavelength optical combs, with a large total bandwidth, and with low driving voltage, and is thus suitable for use as an optical source for optical communications.

a low drive voltage amplitude modulator is an ideal choice for multi-wavelength generation, and that the proposed technique can be used in optical communication systems to provide a cost-effective solution.
a multi-wavelength source with a flatness better than 2 dB and a SMSR of 13 dB has been demonstrated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a multi-wavelength source using two cascaded modulators with low drive voltages is an effective solution for optical communications.

we have shown that it is possible to generate a flat multi-wavelength comb source with 42.66 GHz line-spacing and over 500 GHz bandwidth using only low drive voltage modulators, and that the comb lines can be tuned by changing the drive voltage amplitude of the modulator.
the use of two concatenated modulators with low drive voltage and low chirp is an effective method of generating a multi-wavelength optical source with high performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
by cascading low drive voltage electrooptic modulators, a simple, low cost, and compact multi-wavelength source can be generated.
a low-cost and simple approach to generating multi-wavelength optical combs can be achieved by driving low-voltage amplitude modulator with a sinusoidal signal.

the proposed technique can be used to generate multi-wavelength sources with a large number of comb lines, with a high flatness and SMSR, and with a low drive voltage, which makes this approach a very attractive alternative for multi-wavelength source generation.
